subject: prime-agent
title: Label-gated base-vs-head behavioral eval gate blocks releases on a 28-task SWE comparison
one_why: A pre-release label launches 6 hosted evaluations running the exact PR base and head against 15 SWE-bench Verified + 8 Pro + 5 ScaleSWE tasks on pinned models; the verdict job fails closed, and label removal or head change revokes both durable approval statuses -- far beyond gptme's in-CI evals (nuance: this is a release-blocking paired A/B gate with a documented trust boundary, not a nightly smoke).

subject: prime-agent
title: Destructive-git dirty-tree guard with cd-chain resolution and explicit-intent bypass
one_why: Pattern-matched discard commands (git reset --hard, clean -f, restore .) trigger a per-target git status probe that follows cd chains and git -C and refuses when the target is unresolvable -- a probe-based fail-closed guard, the constructive inverse of nanocoder's regex-denylist anti-pattern; bypass requires an explicit tool arg or env opt-in.

subject: prime-agent
title: agent-session.ts ballooned to 15,101 LOC and interactive-mode.ts to 12,614 LOC
one_why: The fork inherited pi's already-flagged 4k/6.8k product files and grew them ~4x/~2x (~12% of non-test LOC in two files); new subsystems (daemon/, mcp/, refinement/) were filed modularly but bolted onto a session god-object, so pi's 9-rung separation of loop/state from product surface is no longer held.

subject: prime-agent
title: Daemon worker + command recovery journals with session leases and orphan-process journal
evidence: packages/coding-agent/src/modes/daemon/worker-recovery-journal.ts; modes/daemon/command-recovery-journal.ts + test/command-recovery-journal.test.ts; core/session-lease.ts + test/session-lease.test.ts; core/orphan-process-journal.ts + test/orphan-process-journal.test.ts
one_why: Crash recovery for a multi-session supervising daemon is journal-tested rather than asserted -- each recovery mechanism ships with a dedicated spec, the strongest crash-recovery test set in the corpus after codex.

subject: prime-agent
title: RLM recursive subagent registry with user-settable max-depth budget
one_why: Subagents can spawn subagents with a depth budget (default/env/global/inherited/chat sources) and a durable ledger, giving recursive fan-out a cost ceiling pi deliberately never built; nuance vs cline's flat multi-agent-team.

subject: prime-agent
title: semantic-edges-v1: commit-gated causal edge ledger over model requests
one_why: A durable per-agent event ledger derives sparse causal edges between request IDs, materializing edges only when the target request commits and deferring pending edges past racing compaction slices -- crush's provenance tagging lifted to a crash-tolerant causal graph (published as ai.prime.acp/semantic-edges-v1).

subject: prime-agent
title: Refinement: auto-triggered self-edit proposals across prompt/memory/skill/subagent scopes
one_why: On turn-interval or compaction triggers the harness drafts create/update/delete proposals for its own prompts, memories, skills, and subagent definitions in local or global scope -- same proposal-store family as nanocoder, but wider scope and compaction-coupled triggers.

subject: prime-agent
title: No default sandbox and no project-trust gate; SECURITY.md lost pi's threat-model honesty
evidence: grep of /data/samples/agents/prime-agent/packages/coding-agent/src for project-trust/ProjectTrust: zero matches; SECURITY.md:1-40 vs /data/samples/agents/pi/SECURITY.md (trust-boundary paragraphs removed); enforcement is config.beforeToolCall at packages/agent/src/agent-loop.ts:791-810
one_why: Same tested-hook-nothing-underneath posture as pi, but the fork predates pi's project-trust gate and replaced pi's exemplary 'intentionally no sandbox' disclosure with boilerplate -- the honest-boundary credit pi earned at 6 is absent, leaving only the eval-sandbox boundary documented.

subject: prime-agent
title: pi fork adds both ACP mode and a full MCP client with safety-verified catalog
evidence: packages/coding-agent/src/modes/acp/acp-mode.ts (1,224 LOC); core/mcp/mcp-manager.ts (734 LOC) + test/mcp-manager.test.ts, mcp-service-safety.test.ts:1-21, acp-cold-cli.test.ts
one_why: Reverses pi's by-philosophy interop ceiling (6) with ACP + MCP + MCP-over-ACP bridging; the credential-endpoint-binding invariant (mismatched stored credential => zero probes, zero token reads, red-on-baseline adversarial suite) is portable on its own regardless of transport choice.

subject: prime-agent
title: Diff-based test-presence policy gate instead of coverage threshold
evidence: scripts/check-test-policy.mjs:1-25 (resolveBase + testFilePattern); package.json:14 (check chains check:test-policy with biome/tsgo/push-guard)
one_why: CI fails PRs that touch code without touching a matching test file -- a cheaper, more targeted alternative to nanocoder's coverage-percentage gate; no coverage number is enforced.
